description:
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, adding {B}.
When Shipwreck Dowser dies, it and any Wicked Role tokens that may be attached to it trigger.
If applicable, resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, and attaching a Wicked Role token to it.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
